result.description: A fictional portable storage enclosure built for field archiving, media handoff, and offsite backups. TundraLink 9600 pairs a USB4 interface with a preinstalled 1.92 TB NVMe module in a rugged aluminum shell, offering quiet operation, hardware write protection, and tool-free access for rapid drive swaps. It is positioned as a compact data transport device rather than an internal component, and is intended for photographers, editors, and IT teams needing fast removable storage.
